answer: Each epoch demands a fresh attestation from the issuer, and stale or copied records fail the check. Use curling club membership with bonspiel entry records as the proof: bonspiels entered under one club for years. One fake is cheap, but 464 aliases need 464 independent entry records, and the time invested in each is the price the farm pays. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the ridge signal is public, the quill check is automatic, and 464 aliases cost 464 times what one real agent costs, with the spiral trail open to all.
